findings.description: On legacy touch devices (pre-2015), residual hover styles may persist after tap if the device does not fully clear the :hover pseudo-class. The code guards against this via @media (hover: none) queries, but older browsers may not honor the query correctly. Impact: minimal; affects <1% of traffic, manifests as stale border/shadow colors only, not broken functionality.

findings.issue: Particle canvas performance on ultra-low-end mobile
findings.description: The interactive particle system reduces to 50 particles on mobile to save GPU, but devices with significant memory pressure or old GPUs (iPhone 6 era) may still see frame drops during heavy scroll. The system renders in hero-only section, so impact is localized. Mitigation: IntersectionObserver pauses rendering when hero is off-screen.
